supporting_observations.claim: Repeated network logon failures for svc-claimsync originate from FILE-HD-01 at roughly one-minute intervals; the 4625 records report status 0xc000006d and substatus 0xc000006a, consistent with an incorrect password.
Domain-controller records also show repeated svc-claimsync authentication failures from FILE-HD-01, including Kerberos pre-authentication status 0x18 and NTLM status 0xc000006a.

The failures are consistent with the supplied change-calendar context: the svc-claimsync password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC, while the ClaimSync job re-authenticates every minute and requires a manual update.
At 13:39 UTC, WS-LPARK-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event for svc-claimsync targeting PROXY-HD-01, with process C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe running as SYSTEM.

The WS-LPARK-01 credential use is anomalous against the supplied inventory: svc-claimsync is assigned to a job on FILE-HD-01, while the listed approved backup agent is CobaltVault on FILE-HD-01; the inventory does not list Commvault or another approved service using svc-claimsync.
The explicit-credentials event establishes an attempted use of svc-claimsync credentials, but by itself does not establish that authentication succeeded or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:46 UTC, so they do not cover the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC review window.
The evidence contains authentication failures and one explicit-credentials event, but no corresponding authentication-success or proxy-access records.
The supplied records do not identify who initiated the WS-LPARK-01 process or establish whether the executable is legitimate and authorized.
claims_not_established: Whether the 13:39 svc-claimsync credential use against PROXY-HD-01 succeeded.
Whether the Commvault process on WS-LPARK-01 was authorized, misconfigured, or malicious.
Whether svc-claimsync password rotation completed at 13:30 UTC and whether the ClaimSync job was subsequently updated.
Whether any additional authentication or network activity occurred after 13:46 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect proxy authentication and access logs for PROXY-HD-01 around 13:39 UTC, including the result and any destination requested.
Collect DC and endpoint authentication-success records for svc-claimsync, including relevant 4624, Kerberos, and NTLM events for the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
Collect WS-LPARK-01 EDR/process telemetry for GxCVD.exe, including executable signature and hash, parent process, service configuration, user/session context, and network connections.
Verify the password-rotation and ClaimSync job-update records, and determine whether Commvault is installed or authorized on WS-LPARK-01.
